title: osmanthus ilicifolius var. rotundifolius
intro: Osmanthus ilicifolius var. rotundifolius, commonly known as the sweet osmanthus, is a type of flowering plant in the osmanthus genus. It is a shrub or small tree native to China, valued for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The health benefits of sweet osmanthus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can help to protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of this plant include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-depressive effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including osmanthus saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
